_comment: Single source of truth for host SSH targets, IPs, WireGuard peer identities, and per-host desktop/config-file facts. Read by the host-touching skills (ssh-host, journal, remote-rebuild, nix-repl, fleet-status, fleet-rollout, vpn-status, verify-service) AND the package/DE skills (add-package, add-flatpak, switch-de, new-module) instead of each re-typing a copy. Desktop hosts (HM, Flatpak, swappable DE) have `desktop: true`; `envFile` is the host's system-config file. `ip` is the LAN address (DHCP, can drift); `vpnIp` is the WireGuard-hub overlay address (10.10.0.0/24, flake hosts only); `tailscaleIp` is the Tailscale mesh address (100.x.y.z, stable per-device, added 2026-08-18 for all 5 devices — pi-hole/famdash's ssh.nix aliases route over this one specifically since their LAN IPs kept drifting). Update HERE only.

vpn-server.notes: Oracle Cloud ARM VM, public-facing. bosko has passwordless sudo; the Oracle ubuntu cloud-init user no longer accepts the key.

pi-hole.notes: DNS appliance (the nameserver) at 10.0.0.19 (was .20 until an early-Aug 2026 power outage caused DHCP re-lease drift); NOT a flake host. 2026-08-18: joined the Tailscale mesh and ssh.nix's `pi-hole` alias dials the stable tailscaleIp instead of the LAN ip, so future DHCP drift no longer breaks the alias. `ip` (LAN) kept for reference only. bosko@ SSH key trust FIXED same day — gaming's key manually appended to pi-hole's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys via local console (not flake-managed, no declarative path). Confirmed working. No router-side DHCP reservation yet (Xfinity gateway).

famdash.notes: Family dashboard Pi at 10.0.0.20 (was .21 until an early-Aug 2026 power outage caused DHCP re-lease drift; landed on pi-hole's old address). NOT a flake host. 2026-08-18: joined the Tailscale mesh and ssh.nix's `famdash` alias dials the stable tailscaleIp instead of the LAN ip, so future DHCP drift no longer breaks the alias. `ip` (LAN) kept for reference only. natty@ SSH key trust FIXED same day — gaming's key manually appended to famdash's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys via local console (not flake-managed, no declarative path). Confirmed working. No router-side DHCP reservation yet (Xfinity gateway).
